examples.fr: La confiance mutuelle est le fondement de toute relation durable.
examples.en: Mutual trust is the foundation of any lasting relationship.

examples.fr: Cette accusation est dénuée de tout fondement sérieux.
examples.en: This accusation is devoid of any serious basis.

reasons: example 2 misused 'fondement' for a building's physical foundation (that is 'fondations'); replaced with a natural use meaning basis/grounds
